These are unchanged reference-only R source files from pinned CRAN archives. missMDA and FactoMineR are GPL (>= 2); author and license metadata are retained in their DESCRIPTION files. No R code ships in the application. sources.json pins archive URLs and hashes and individual file hashes. The R generator sources FactoMineR svd.triplet unchanged, then adapts exactly the namespace call FactoMineR::svd.triplet in imputePCA to that same local function. This is a source adapter, not a claim that the entire missMDA package was installed or executed. All calculations and control flow in the adapted function remain unchanged.
